rows.en: (Ugh... the morning sun is so bright...)
(I really shouldn't stay up so late...)

Such good manners! You make this big sis
so happy...
(I probably shouldn't comment on that, huh.)
rows.notes: tsukkomu = to call out Bobby's 'big sis'.

rows.en:
I was going to ask how you've been, but
you don't look so great...

Your complexion is just aaawful!
You're wasting that handsome face of yours!
I don't think I'm all that handsome...
Are you taking proper care of your skin?
I wash my face with soap.

Sigh...
And so the bud withers before it ever blooms...

To Heaven!
The secret room where you'll be reborn!!

Well?
Don't you feel like a whole new person?
Yes, it's like my face belongs to someone else.

From now on, don't lean on your youth.
Polish yourself up on your own!
You'll never be a first-class man like that!

(That's the first time anyone's ever done
my makeup...)

rows.notes: Bobby drops the feminine speech for a rough masculine yell (oi, mateya); kept rough, no swear added.

rows.en:
Your complexion is just aaawful!
You're wasting that cutie face of yours!
I just wash my face and use toner.
You're free right now, aren't you?
Yes, my face looks like someone else's...

From now on, don't lean on your youth.
Polish yourself up on your own, okay!

You'll never be a first-class lady like that,
you know?

(So Bobby-san really did use to be
a makeup artist...)
rows.notes: moto meiku-san = former makeup artist (Bobby's backstory).

rows.en:
(Hmm... what should I get for a Christmas
present?)

Oh my, \p-chan.
Why the long face?

Bobby-san!
Thanks for the other day...
rows.notes: sono setsu wa doumo: thanks for the makeover.

rows.en: Don't mention it. I do it because I love it.

So, what's wrong?
Why don't you talk it over with big sis?

It's just, I can't decide what to get
for a Christmas present.
Oh my, is it for your girlfriend?

No way!
It's for the Christmas party.
Back when I was young, Christmas meant...
rows.notes: Trails off into a long story (cut).

rows.en:
...and that's how I used to spend my
Christmases.
(He talked my ear off for almost an hour...)
rows.notes: Male version; subject is Bobby (male per glossary).

rows.en: You're buying a present, aren't you?

Let me pick out the perfect present
for y-o-u.
rows.notes: a-ge-ru spelled out teasingly; mirrored with y-o-u.

rows.en: You're so happy you're speechless. I get it!

Guiding lost little kittens is a grown-up's
duty.

rows.notes: Shared by both versions; 'he' = Bobby (male per glossary).

uncertain: c00398/c00442: baibi~ rendered 'ta-ta~' for Bobby's camp register.
c00403: Bobby's sudden rough male speech rendered 'Oi! Get back here, you!!' to carry the rough male register without adding a swear.
